noise.description: Noise is randomness that remembers its neighbors. Where pure entropy forgets instantly, noise maintains continuity—each value smoothly related to those around it. This is the λ parameter tuned for coherence: structured disorder, organic unpredictability, entropy constrained by smoothness. Perlin and Simplex noise are the algorithms that make chaos usable—random enough to be surprising, continuous enough to be natural.
